about: Five-engine hypotheses for five units of one Earnings-22 call (revdotcom/speech-datasets earnings22, CC-BY-SA-4.0), taken from the ASR benchmark fusion inputs: Q is Qwen3-ASR-1.7B (q-lidc), P Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 fp32 greedy, C Cohere Transcribe, W Whisper large-v3, K Canary-1b-v2. Words are in the benchmark scoring space (number-normalized, lowercase), confidences as the benchmark rounded them; C, W and K report none. `expected` is what the benchmark ROVER (build, vote, regions) returned for the same input: `conf` at alpha 0.4, null 0.5, default confidence 0.7 over QPCWK; `freq` at alpha 1.0 over QPCWK; `qp` at alpha 0.4 over Q and P; `regions` over QPCWK, an agreed word as a string and a disagreement region as its columns (null for no word).
